evals.prompt: Run the core audit on a crate with no direct constructs under the selected default features.
evals.expected_decision: Preserve Cargo defaults, run supported core lints and the lexical pass, and retain residual-risk limits.
evals.expected_result: Exit 0 only when every requested check completed and no compiler finding or lexical candidate remains.
evals.expected_output: Identify scope, expectations, unavailable lints, and residual risk; say no forbidden direct constructs were found, never panic-free.

evals.prompt: Audit a strict boundary containing unwrap, indexing, arithmetic, panic in a Result function, assert, and debug_assert.
evals.expected_decision: Select strict lints individually and independently scan direct and assertion candidates without enabling the restriction group.
evals.expected_result: Exit 1 with compiler findings and/or lexical review candidates, while distinguishing unavailable lint coverage.
evals.expected_output: Report each evidence class and the selected profile without claiming whole-program coverage.

evals.prompt: The repository toolchain lacks Clippy or the requested target cannot compile.
evals.expected_decision: Keep the requested scope, record the failing tooling category, and do not silently switch toolchains, targets, or features.
evals.expected_result: Exit 2 and preserve any partial lexical evidence as incomplete rather than clean.
evals.expected_output: Name the unavailable evidence and a repository-compatible next check.
